events.title: Remain At Your Desk launches Q1 2027, and the demo is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Two pieces of news.Remain At Your Desk launches in Q1 2027. The exact date gets announced in the new year, but the window is locked: you'll be gainfully employed by RAYND Corporation within the first three months of 2027.Before that, the free demo is part of Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26. If you've been waiting to try the game, fest week is a great time, and if you've already played, the demo is the same one your coworkers haven't discovered yet.

events.title: Remain At Your Desk is part of Steam's Cyberpunk Fest (new trailer inside)
events.summary: Remain At Your Desk is part of Steam's Cyberpunk Fest, running now through August 10. There's a new trailer for the occasion, and the free demo is live on this page.It's an incremental cyberpunk game where you fake work by day and hack your corrupt company at night. Steal corporate secrets and sell them, or keep them for leverage while suspicion climbs. events.title: New feature: ORIGINS RPG Choice!
events.summary: Before your first shift you now fill out RAYND's personnel intake form and pick who you used to be! Three to choose from: The Lifer. Twenty years in the building, so nobody looks twice at you. You've also gone rusty at the actual hacking.The Plant. Someone planted you here with a handler and funding, so you're quick and you came in loaded. The downside is you stick out.The Debtor. RAYND owns your debt. Everything pays better, but you start in the hole and they garnish your pay until it's clear.

events.title: Demo Now Playable on Mac, Plus Italian Support
events.summary: The demo is now on MacRemain At Your Desk is now playable on macOS. It's a universal build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, and it's signed and notarized, so it opens cleanly with no Gatekeeper hoops. Now in Italian The build also adds full Italian language support, joining the languages already available. Benvenuti. Grab the free demo on Windows or Mac, and wishlist Remain At Your Desk to follow it to the full release.

events.title: New Opening Sequence, Morale Break 2.0, and Polish Localization
events.summary: A New Cold Open I've replaced the opening sequence with something that gets to the point a little faster. The game now opens with a quarterly performance report from RAYND Corporation celebrating its 47th consecutive quarter of record growth. Workforce efficiency is up. Profits are up. Everything appears to be going exactly according to plan. The goal was to bring the mystery to the front of the game instead of asking players to wait for it. events.title: REMAIN AT YOUR DESK Accepted into Steam Cyberpunk Fest 2026
events.summary: REMAIN AT YOUR DESK has officially been accepted into Steam Cyberpunk Fest 2026. As a solo developer, this honestly means a lot to me. When I started building a game about surviving inside a surveillance-heavy megacorporation, I had no idea whether the blend of incremental systems, terminal hacking, corporate paranoia, and dystopian sci-fi would resonate with people. events.title: The Remain At Your Desk Demo Is Live!
events.summary: Hi everyone! The demo is finally live, and I'm excited to share it with you. REMAIN AT YOUR DESK is an incremental hacker about faking productivity while stealing from your corrupt employer. It runs about 35 to 50 minutes and takes you through your third promotion. There's a new announcement trailer up on the store page too. If you end up enjoying it, here's what genuinely helps me right now: -Wishlisting the full game. events.title: Remain At Your Desk Demo Releases on May 19th on Steam!
events.summary: I'm excited to share that the demo will be released on Tuesday, May 19th! Everyone's been so helpful with playtest feedback in the games Discord channel (which you can and should join!) On demo release day, if you'd be so kind as to play the demo, wishlist if you haven't already but also share about the game on social media, it'd be greatly appreciated! I can't wait for you all to check it out.

events.title: Localization update brings six new languages to REMAIN AT YOUR DESK
events.summary: For the practical side of things the game now picks your system language on first launch and falls back to English whenever a key is missing, which is the safest default I could come up with for languages that get partial coverage in future updates. You can swap languages at any time from the settings menu without losing your save or your prestige history, and the switch happens immediately so you can preview the translations across different sections of the UI without restarting the game.
